responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s Unicode text utilities, centered on NFC normalization and Unicode property classification. This file consumes the generated tables from rust-unicode-data.h to perform canonical decomposition, combining-class ordering, Hangul algorithmic decomposition/composition, recomposition, NFC quick-check evaluation, and alphabetic/numeric/ASCII predicates, and it provides Utf8String normalization behavior plus selftests, making it the executable core of Rust Unicode handling in the frontend.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the rust-unicode pair: it executes NFC normalization and Unicode property checks using rust-unicode-data.h tables, including decomposition/recomposition, Hangul handling, quick-check evaluation, and selftests. rust-unicode.h instead defines the Utf8String interface and declares the public predicates/APIs.
